machine_note: Pre-CAM plan for a stave-shell cylindrical tongue drum. Verify actual CNC router, lathe swing, clamps, feed/speed, bit stickout, and air-cut before machining.
assumptions: V1 target is the medium 12 in OD x 16 in long stave-cylinder prototype.
Tongue pitches depend on final wall thickness, so stock prep and turning checks are tuning-critical.
The CNC tongue operation needs either a rigid V-block with rotary indexing or a true rotary axis.

operations.name: Review workbook, drawings, and datums
operations.datum: Shell axis A, left end B, right end C, equator D, index zero E
checks: C minor vs D minor decision visible
End configuration selected or marked TBD
No CAM until SolidWorks unwrap is reviewed
operations.notes: Preserve all TBDs instead of burying them in CAM assumptions.

operations.name: Cut and thickness stave blanks
operations.machine: Table saw, jointer, planer, drum sander
operations.tool: Sharp rip/crosscut blade, planer knives, calipers
operations.datum: Outside face and long edge of each stave
operations.notes: Cut extra stock for destructive tongue and finish tests.

operations.name: Glue stave cylinder
operations.tool: Band clamps, hose clamps, cauls, glue brush
operations.datum: Shell axis A established by roundness checks
checks: Seam positions logged for tongue layout
operations.notes: Tongue roots should avoid weak seam locations where possible.

operations.name: Turn shell to OD, ID, and wall thickness
operations.tool: Bowl gouge, scraper, calipers, wall-thickness gauge
operations.workholding: Chuck/faceplate with tailstock support as appropriate
outputs: 12 in OD, 11 in ID, 0.5 in wall shell
checks: No thin spots below 0.5 in before tongue cuts
operations.notes: Final wall is the tongue thickness in f = K*t/L^2.

operations.name: Prepare end configuration
operations.machine: Lathe, drill press, band saw, bench
operations.tool: Forstner bits, hole saw, turning tools, sanding blocks
outputs: sealed caps, ported cap, or drumhead-ready rim
checks: Port diameter and neck length measured if ported
operations.notes: Do not drill hardware for drumhead until the actual hardware is sourced.

operations.name: Create wrap template and index plan
operations.machine: Laser cutter, printer, or SolidWorks drawing export
operations.tool: Paper template, laser-safe sheet, marking knife
operations.workholding: Template taped to shell with index zero
operations.datum: Equator plane D and index zero E
checks: Tongue lengths include tuning trim allowance
operations.notes: SolidWorks unwrap should replace the temporary SVG-derived template.

operations.name: CNC cut tongue slits
operations.workholding: Rigid V-block cradle, clamps clear of toolpath, rotary index marks
operations.datum: Shell axis A, equator D, index zero E
checks: Shell cannot rotate/slip during final cut
No tongue crosses a weak seam without approval
operations.notes: Cut one tongue, re-index, re-clamp, and verify before the next cut unless a true rotary axis is used.

operations.name: Tune tongues and validate body coupling
operations.tool: Chromatic tuner, microphone, file, Dremel, sanding block
operations.notes: Shorten tongue tip to raise pitch. Thin near root only with caution.

release_checks: Every operation has a datum and workholding method.
CNC operations have a fixture and clamp plan.
All tuning-critical dimensions include measurement checkpoints.
No file claims to be verified CAM or G-code.
Validation.csv is updated after prototype measurements.
